tenderSchedule.title: Procurement of APH Main Drive Gear box for 700MW
tenderSchedule.description: Procurement of Air preheater main drive gear box for 700MW boiler
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer Purchase Office BTPS Bellary

tenderAddress.blockNumber: OFFICE OF THE EXECUTIVE ENGINEER PURCHASE, BTPS, KPCL, KUDATHINI

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have supplied Gear boxes for Air preheaters of Boiler capacity 500MW & above to any power producers/Major Industry. As a proof, purchase order of value Rs. 94 Lakh or above in a single order in preceding five financial years (2021-22, 2022-2023, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). As a proof bidder shall upload the original scanned PO copy.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Signed copies of previous PO

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should be OEM/OES Authorised Manufacturer/ Authorized dealer/ Channel partner of Lufkin Industries, Inc. Lufkin, Texas / supplier of APH main drive gear box/ Mills planetary gearbox / Coal handling system gear box to 500MW & above TPS/ Major industry in India, shall do declare(Annexure-II) and supply as per our technical specification.

The intending bidder in his name should have achieved an annual financial turnover of Rs.380 Lakh for any two years during the last five years. As a proof, the bidder shall upload among previous five years. The bidder shall furnish a copy of financial certificates such as audited balance sheet and P&L statements (for any two years among previous five years ie.,(2021-22,2022-23,2023-24,2024-25,2025-26) duly certified by a chartered Accountant to establish annual turnover requirement stipulated above.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder shall have GST registrations & shall furnish copy of certificate as a documentary proof.
The declaration duly signed in the prescribed format (Annexure - II) has to be enclosed.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Annual Turnover/Audited balance sheet and P&L statement
